item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Nov 06
item.description:
27 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Backpacks now count toward mission items, tech tree unlocks, and vending machine requirements.
  • Resolved crashes and sound errors when crab or bird movement sounds were destroyed.
  • Prevented sound manager errors when recycling already-recycled sounds.
  • Corrected floating visual glitch of harbor containers on cargo ships.
  • Fixed level unloading order to ensure proper map reloads.
  • Added guard against NRE in player ping transmission.
  • Ensured inventory preview reappears correctly after map reloads.
  • Eliminated client crashes when network LOD accessed destroyed entities, such as dead boats.
  • Fixed tablet painting to maintain continuous strokes during fast drawing.
  • Stopped NRE spam from PlayerBoat wake effects when network LOD is active.
  • Cleared residual map networkables on load to prevent lingering issues.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Nov 05
item.description:
75 development commits

AI & Events

  • Boat scientists no longer stay locked onto hidden targets for too long, fixing prolonged invisibility.
  • Roaming boat groups now reliably attack players on the beach.
  • NPC phone calls no longer exceed the MaxConcurrentCalls limit, preventing call spam.
  • Coast runs during the scientist boat event now function correctly, with groups approaching and driving along the shore in formation.
  • Fixed rockets colliding with large seagull group collider and prevented seagulls from disappearing when they can't find a landing spot.

Vehicles

  • Stolen PT boats now persist after the roaming boat event ends unless crew is lost.

Weapons

  • UZI 9mm now correctly scales attached mods (flashlight, barrel) thanks to new AttachmentMountScale component.

Inventory & Crafting

  • Moving items to/from backpack slot 7 no longer triggers incorrect backpack equip/unequip events and reduces unnecessary server updates.
  • Primitive mode supply drops now include blueprint pages.
  • Added experimental UI that shows all items craftable with a selected ingredient, helping players discover recipes.

Server & Social

  • Server favorites and history now list reliably; IP:port saved instantly and DNS fallback improved.
  • Contact list notes are now saved properly.

Audio

  • Travelling vendor vehicles no longer produce missing tire sound errors or lingering visual ticks after being destroyed.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Doors now reliably swing dynamically without causing crashes.
  • NPC encounter timers function correctly, preventing missed or delayed encounters.
  • Player and horse modifiers are pooled correctly, fixing missing buffs/debuffs.
  • Locked crates retain the correct unlock timer after restarting the game.
  • Gamepad focus no longer crashes, improving controller navigation.

UI & Quality of Life

  • PT boat turret UI now correctly shows an empty magazine when out of ammo.

Demo & Recording

  • Demo recordings can now exceed 240 fps and maintain smooth timescale below 0.2, fixing stutter.

Skins & Visuals

  • Weapon skins now stay applied while thrown and workshop skins no longer reset mid‑load.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Nov 04
item.description:
117 development commits

Combat & Weapons

  • Reload animation now resets correctly when switching identical guns, preventing unintended continuous reloads.
  • Ballista bolts are functional again, restoring ranged siege capability.
  • Melee attacks no longer cause crashes, ensuring stable combat.
  • Turrets now fire at their intended automatic rate when placed.

Vehicles & Transportation

  • Tomaha snowmobile can be prepared without errors, restoring its use.
  • Railway tracks no longer become buried by terrain; a world‑setup step raises them, improving rail visuals and workcart operation.

World & Spawn

  • Hoppers now correctly collect body bags.
  • Beach spawn points fixed: players spawn only on true beaches, and lighthouses no longer appear inland.
  • Lighthouse and brown crates now spawn above ground, making loot accessible.

AI & Animals

  • Snakes now collide properly with world layers, no longer ride horses, and take explosion damage as intended.

Items, Loot & Decay

  • Alien costume is craftable again.
  • Seagull corpses now drop extra resources.
  • Stashes decay over time again, with adjustable duration via a console variable.

World & Mechanics

  • Dynamic monument map markers can now update their label and position in real time, improving navigation to changing points of interest.
  • Rail lifts no longer suffer from floating rails at junctions, preventing visual glitches and potential traversal issues.
  • Old cave monument prefabs have been removed from procedural generation, cleaning up cave layouts.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Water wheel control menu no longer crashes due to a null reference, restoring access to wheel settings.
  • Tattoo files are now stored correctly after merging, ensuring player tattoos persist and display properly.
  • Opening the items tab during loading no longer triggers a UI error, allowing smoother inventory access.
  • Item pickup notifications are fixed, so players receive proper feedback when collecting items.
